author: Keel (brief 010, 2026-10-15)
rule: Every event the city simulation runs: what it needs, what it charges, what it changes and who sees it (GDD §11: events carry conditions, effects, witnesses). Anything not in this file or in people.rules.json is rejected (§01: unknown = reject). Scales, temperaments, needs, ties, the Talker test, knowledge and the reference approach prices are read from people.rules.json through p: refs and condition kinds, never restated here. Every number lives once in `values`, tagged as the GDD tags it: [B] built and proven in the top-down test, [S] starting value to tune by playtest, [L] later; a value or rule the GDD does not decide carries proposed: true and a reason, for Sky. Conditions are keyed by `k`, effects by `do`, always the first key, so the C# engine reads them as tagged unions. Outcomes are tried in order and the first whose conditions all hold applies; the last has none, so every event resolves to exactly one outcome. `also` entries apply after the outcome, in order.

reads: scales: min, max and named steps; every move clamps to them
temperaments: respondsTo, refuses and reportsApproach decide an approach's fit; start values
approaches: requires, usd, timeS and trail are the base price line of each Turn event
needs.list: metBy (which approach acts on a need), requires (what a replacement need may need)
knowledge: needsKnown positions (K9), identity face only, learnedBy witnessed or told
tiers: only the simulated carry memory and can be questioned (Sky Q5)

tags.B: built: proven in the top-down test (~/Projects/the-suborned/testbed/reference/suborned-world-sim.cjs) or stated [B] in the GDD
tags.S: spec: a starting value the GDD states [S], tuned by playtest

units.s: integer seconds; the engine steps at 10 Hz (§11), so 1 s = 10 ticks
units.standing: district standing, integer: above 0 Hero, below 0 Menace
units.orders: orders of the same approach to the same person
units.hops: ties crossed by one piece of news
units.per-mille: integer weight scale for seeded draws

watch-s.src: Sky 2026-10-15 (Motive's balance, briefs/011/motive-balance.md): Watch 20 s; §04 Pay requires routine known (Watch); the top-down test's watchCafe was 52 s [B]
watch-s.reason: Motive balance (brief 011, Suture E-8, T2): at 52 s the informed route A calls at 2:42 and loud (3:38) beats it. At 20 s the call is at 2:10, inside the 2:13-2:47 sweep gap, and route A finishes at 3:33, 5 s before the best loud. Watch keeps its place in the chain (Watch, then Listen, then Help) and Sky's Pay lesson stays on the main path: after Watch the Pay card shows '?' and $90,000 worst case. Sky's steer to more real-time also argues for shorter prep timers.

watch-sight-reach-m.src: Sky 2026-10-16: view cones are the Scout's skill (Glyph, briefs/011/ui/review-2026-10-16 §3.4: a watcher within 18 m on a clear line)
watch-sight-reach-m.reason: the GDD gives no reach for watching a watcher. A camera or a patrol is watched from across the street, not from beside it as a person is (act-reach-m 6 m): 18 m is a walking guard's sight (facing-reach-m), so the Scout can watch from outside most cones but not from anywhere.

watch-routine-s.src: Sky 2026-10-16: a timed Watch also teaches the watcher's routine (stage 2; Aster's brief to Keel)
watch-routine-s.reason: the GDD gives no time. Two Watches (2 × watch-s) of a watcher with a cycle (the patrol's sweep) teach when it turns and when it sees the door: the price of a timing plan is Scout time, set against Reroute (45 s and 1 Trail) that it can replace. Motive prices it.

worse-pay-usd.reason: Pay's step is money. $20,000 is twice the refusal surcharge, so a wrong approach costs more than a cold ask's leftover, and it keeps every §04 lesson: a Mercenary is cheapest by Pay ($70,000 < Help ×2 $80,000), a Fearful or Loyal person is cheaper by Help ($80,000 < $90,000) but slower (100 s vs 50 s), and Pay plus the driver stays over the purse.

worse-pressure-trail.src: §04 wrong approach [S] (Sky Q4): a higher price; Pressure's price is Trail
worse-pressure-trail.reason: Pressure costs no money, so its step is +1 T (a louder threat), in one order. A second threat instead would add a second +1 resentment and make an Informer of anyone not Fearful (resentment max 2): a cliff, not a step.

loyal-help-orders.reason: 'repeated' read as the smallest repeat: one Help more than anyone else, so a Loyal person turns on the second Help even though Help suits them.

standing-start.src: Sky 2026-10-16 ('Hero is kinda the default, if you're not seen then everyone assumes you're good (it's that kinda world)'); briefs/014/motive-standing.md rule 1 (approved by Sky, 'sure', 2026-10-16); was 0
standing-start.reason: Motive: every district starts leaning Hero, one step short of the Hero band, so one known kindness earns the band. Starting at +3 would put the Handover in Hero prices from the first second and change its tested costs; at +2 every in-mission price stays neutral.

standing-step.src: §04 standing: witnessed acts only; §05 witness moves standing
standing-step.reason: one step per witnessed incident, as Trail counts one point per incident: one incident counts once.

hero-at.src: §04 standing table (turning, crowds, fights, street change at each end)
hero-at.reason: the Hero and Menace columns need a threshold. Three witnessed incidents one way make a district Hero (or Menace at −3): a mission or two of deliberate play, so the player sees it coming and chooses it.

word-standing-step.src: Sky 2026-10-16 ('if you help in a good way then can move to hero'); briefs/014/motive-standing.md rules 2 and 3
word-standing-step.reason: Motive: between missions each person the cell helped tells their ties a stranger helped them (+1), and each person it pressured or knocked out tells of the harm (−1): one step per person, not per tie, so a large family is no lever.

word-standing-cap.src: Sky 2026-10-16 ('if you help in a good way then can move to hero'); briefs/014/motive-standing.md rules 2 and 3
word-standing-cap.reason: Motive: the word moves a district at most 2 steps either way in one mission, so turning a crowd of kind strangers cannot buy the Hero band outright and a bad mission's word cannot sink a district alone; seen and found acts stay uncapped.

standing-drift.src: Sky 2026-10-16 (approved Motive's 'the benefit of the doubt'); briefs/014/motive-standing.md rule 5
standing-drift.reason: Motive: what the city stops seeing, it forgives. A district where nothing moved Standing this mission moves 1 step back toward standing-start, from either side, never past it: unkept Hero fades back to +2 as Menace does, so Hero is kept by doing good and a Menace cell is not stuck.

fight-standing-step.src: Sky 2026-10-16 (via Aster: 'it should be per fight, and depends who you're fighting - a rival gang that has menace level authority is a +1'); briefs/014/motive-standing.md, a public fight, rule 3
fight-standing-step.reason: Motive: the public judges a fight by its enemy, once per fight: one step, toward Menace for a fight with authority or for firing first on rivals nobody fears, toward Hero for driving off a crew the district fears.

When full the oldest goes: an old sighting is forgotten, which is the GDD's 'sightings go stale' (§05 counters) made a rule. Fixed size suits the engine's integer arrays.

word-hops.src: Motive K3: word passes along ties between missions, one hop; §04 knowledge [S] (Sky Q6): news travels along ties as facts

word-quiet-loyalty.src: §01 pillar subvert people: does knowing more make a person quieter?; Motive's review #10 (briefs/010/motive-rulebook-review.md)
word-quiet-loyalty.reason: a person who owes the cell (obliged or more) keeps what they saw to themselves; one Help, which needs a Listen, is enough; at 2 a helped Inez would lie to investigators and still tell her family the Fixer's face. Obliged is also the line for reporting and selling.

standing.rule: One integer per district, starting at `start` (one step short of the Hero band: Sky 2026-10-16, 'Hero is kinda the default'). At or above `hero` the district is in the Hero band, at or below `menace` in the Menace band, otherwise neutral. In a mission only acts seen or found move it: each witnessed incident of a Hero act adds one `step`, of a Menace act takes one (traceable[].standing, witness.sees), a public fight moves it once when it ends, by whom the cell fought (fight.public, Sky 2026-10-16: 'it should be per fight, and depends who you're fighting'; not capped, and a move for the drift), and a found killing moves it takedown.foundKillStanding; a missing person moves nothing. Facts along ties never move it (Sky Q6). Between missions the word does (standing.word): each person the cell helped, pressured or knocked out this mission, alive, not missing and with a tie of a kind in `word.ties`, tells those ties how a stranger treated them, once per person, not per tie: helped +`word.step`, pressured or knocked out −`word.step`; a person both helped and harmed counts as harmed (a threat outweighs a kindness). The word's net move in a district is clamped to ±`word.cap` a mission; seen and found acts are never capped. The word is a feeling, not a fact: no face, place or time and nothing about the cell goes with it, so it is no fact for word.passes, the Talker test or the investigators, and word-quiet-loyalty does not stop it. Then (standing.drift) a district where nothing moved Standing this mission (no act seen or found, in the mission or after it, and no word) moves `drift` back toward `start`, from either side, never past it. The debrief carries one Standing line per district (debrief.lines.standing) with its cause, one of `causes`: the cause that moved it most toward the net change (the earliest on a tie), `balanced` when the moves cancel, a drift, or `steady`. Heat (§06) = campaign Trail + max(0, −standing), unchanged: from the start it takes 3 net Menace steps before Standing adds Heat, and Hero never cancels Trail; its threshold is Motive's.

standing.reason: the GDD names the axis and what moves it but gives it no scale. A signed integer with two thresholds is the least that lets the temperament table's Hero and Menace columns apply. Sky 2026-10-16: turning is private, which left nothing moving the city toward Hero; Motive's rules let a kindness reach the district through the person helped, and let the city forgive what it stops seeing.

alert.rule: An incident is one act at one place and time; every shot of one fight with one target is one incident. However many people see or report it, an incident adds witness Trail once, moves standing once, applies the violence move once and raises Alert once: the nth reported incident of a mission raises Alert to at least byIncident[n−1]. Any gunfire raises Alert to at least `gunfire` (§05's own rule; Sky 2026-10-15, briefs/011/motive-fights.md retires §06's +1 A a shot), and calls the response unit. Violence seen by a civilian sets violenceSeen at once. Alert never falls within a mission.

memory.rule: A memory entry is {act, by, place, time, witnessed} (Motive K1). `by` is the face of the operative who did the act: a face is only an id (Adams 2017), and only the Fixer's face is a fact (people.rules talker.facts; §03 the face witnesses remember), so an entry whose `by` is a key of faceFacts also yields that fact. `witnessed` = a third person saw the act. Only a `remember` change writes memory, only acts listed here, only on simulated people (people.rules tiers; Sky Q5). A told entry carries the fact it was told and is never retold (one hop). The facts a person holds are the union over their entries; people.rules talker.lie's `helped` is an entry of act `help`; a remembered refusal is an entry of act `refusal`. An entry yields its act's facts as listed here, plus the face fact of `by` (faceFacts). Brief 013 (Sky D3): the Enforcer's face is a fact, scoped to the new acts: a witness of a takedown (saw-takedown) and a victim who saw him coming (attacked-aware) hold enforcer-face; older entries by the Enforcer (a run, a shot, a drawn weapon) keep yielding place and time only, so every recorded run's debrief stands.

privacy.rule: A turning conversation is private (Sky 2026-10-16). An event marked private (Listen, Ask, Pay, Help) has no witnesses: onlookers within witness range learn nothing from it, so it makes no witness fact or memory, no witness Trail, no Standing move, no incident for the investigators, nothing told along ties and no word between missions, and its card counts nobody who would see it. The event's own price stands: its base Trail (Pay is still traceable money), its time and cash, and the subject's own memory and report (a Loyal person still reports an approach). Pressure is not private: a threat is visible, and onlookers see it, remember it and pass it on (witness.sees). Every event by the Fixer or the Scout says whether it is private; a private event may carry no witnesses. Watch is no conversation (not private) and no traceable act (no witnesses): watching someone shows nothing. The traceable acts payment and debt-cleared stay in `traceable` for a visible act that is not a conversation; no turning verb makes them now.
privacy.src: Sky 2026-10-16: "seeing someone being turned isn't a concern. That's too much, would consider the conversation private, unless it's pressure"

cell.rule: The cell's verbs other than Turn, Watch and Listen (§03): how long each takes, how near the operative must stand, the Trail it leaves. An act on a device or a door (Loop and Reroute at the cabinet, Enter at the public door, Extract at the getaway car) is done at it, within `atReach`; acts on people keep `reach` (Sky 2026-10-15 playtest). Carry: an operative lifts a downed one in `carry`, then walks only and doesn't fire; a downed operative not brought to the getaway car is captured. An order takes its time and lands at its end; a Call lands at once (the top-down test's spill: the guard walks from the call). Running (Sky 2026-10-15, briefs/011/motive-fights.md): a move with run at runSpeed; refused while carrying Vale or a downed operative, while the Tech holds a loop, or while doing an action; a runner is noticed where an act would be: people remember where and when (and the Fixer's face), security that sees it counts a found fault (runAlert, once per run). Running is free while a fight is on. Enter takes enter.alarm longer once Alert ≥ 2 (the staff hide Vale). Loop: the cabinet loops one camera at a time, one of `loop.targets` (a camera of the site by id, or `world`: the city's own cameras, the Records Square mast); the pickup camera joined the list on Sky's answer 6 (2026-10-16: "if the tech takes out the camera, then taking out the guard and driver is possible"; Waymark, briefs/013/waymark-handover.md §5.1).

security.rule: Who answers gunfire and how fast. A report calls the response unit (`weapons.health.responseOfficers` officers); the earliest arrival wins and the district seals after it arrives (the seal is the security level's, `response.levels`). The delay is by who reported: a civilian witness, a guard, camera or patrol that saw it, nobody (unseen), a civilian shot. These delays are the arrivals at security level 1 (routine, today's 12 s dispatch): at another level a report lands the same seconds after the shot and the unit rolls that level's dispatch later, so the arrival moves by the dispatch's difference. A downed guard is missed at his next check-in mark (`response.checkIn`; brief 013 retires the 18 s check-in). Gunfire draws the rivals within `rivals.drawn` and the patrol within `patrol.breakTo`. A hostile who first sees the cell outside a fight reacts in `weapons.react`, then fires at its weapon's cadence (Sky 2026-10-15, briefs/011/motive-fights.md: replaces aim 3 s and the per-unit fire rates).
security.src: §05 security [B], rivals [B]; §06 prototype [B]; the top-down test (Suture M-3: the rulebook carries them, src the prototype)

weapons.rule: Who carries what and how a shot lands (Sky 2026-10-15, briefs/011/motive-fights.md). The Enforcer carries the carbine (the cell's); every other operative may carry a pistol, one per `sidearmArms` of Arms (the Handover issues all three); the guard, the patrol, officers and rivals carry pistols; the Enforcer, officers, the guard and the patrol are trained. A shot's accuracy is its band's (inside `pointBlank`, inside the weapon's eff, inside its max) times each modifier that applies, in per mille: the shooter walking (`mod.moving`), the target still beside cover (`mod.cover`), the Enforcer holding Vale (`mod.vale`), an untrained shooter (`mod.untrained`). Hits are deterministic: each shooter keeps an integer accumulator on its target, starting at `acc.start`; each shot adds the accuracy, and at 1000 or more the shot hits and 1000 comes off (750: exactly three in four). A shot does the weapon's damage; health per kind is `health`, at 0 down. The cost moves from the shot to the victim: +`costs.gunfire` T once per shooting (the first shot at each target, hit or miss), +`costs.hit` T per person hit, once, and +`costs.down` more when they go down; the final fight stays untraced (fight.traced). A drawn weapon seen by security raises Alert to `costs.drawSeenSecurity` and that watcher engages; seen by people, it is one witnessed incident (Alert at least `costs.drawSeenPeople`, standing per traceable weapon-drawn), and drawings within `costs.drawWindow` and witness range of it are the same incident (Motive addendum 2026-10-15). Orders: draw (`draw` ticks), holster (`holster`), stance (hold, return, free), fire until down (first shot `aimNew` after taking the target; holds aim `lineLapse` when the line breaks), cease, panic (once a fight is on). A civilian or a contact is a target only when the order says so (the Ctrl case).
weapons.reason: Sky approved Motive's five answers on 2026-10-15; the numbers are Motive's calculator's (briefs/011/motive-fights/fights.py), [S] until Suture's frontier runs on the engine.

ai.rule: What a hostile does in a fight (Pulse, briefs/011/pulse-fight-ai.md §2–3; Sky approved real-time shoot-outs, briefs/011/motive-fights.md). One machine: routine, alerted (react; summoned bodies skip it; an ambush waits weapons.aimNew, plus fight.safe.warn if Inez warned), advance (to the cover point the site's cover data gives, else to stopReach of its weapon's effective reach short of its foe or objective; fires nothing while it moves), engage (a foe inside its effective reach on a clear line: stops, takes its target by class: 1 whoever fired at it within weapons.lineLapse, 2 the operative holding Vale, 3 the nearest with a weapon drawn, 4 the nearest; keeps it until down, out of reach or sight for lineLapse, or a better class appears; a new target costs aimNew; steps to cover when unprotected, once each cover.stepGap, and leaves a point unprotected for cover.leave), hold (holders: police, the patrol, a guard; a target reacquired within reacquire is shot at once), break (rivals: more than half the crew down; they run for their car and are gone within rivalGone; no longer combatants, no longer hold the car, no Trail), down. Lapse to hold or advance after engageLapse with no foe in reach. A body beside a cover point (cover.snap) that shields it, standing still, past point blank, is hit at weapons.mod.cover (quality ≥ qFull) or modPartial (≥ qPartial). One body to a cover point. Seek: how far each looks for cover. Police (officers) hold their stand and never break; the response unit joins the loud fight at the nearest police stand (overflow beside a taken one, else the nearest free cover within seek.police); the guard ally runs to his post, taking cover within seek.ally; an engaging guard fights from where he stands and stands down guardReturn after his last foe; the patrol chases to the shot's origin and resumes its sweep patrolResume after its last foe. Shots resolve together at the end of a tick. The crowd's scatter (Pulse §4) is not in yet.
ai.src: Pulse, briefs/011/pulse-fight-ai.md (brief 011); Sky 2026-10-15 approved Motive's briefs/011/motive-fights.md
ai.reason: Pulse's spec, every number his proposal and Motive's to tune; the crowd's values wait for the crowd's states.

crowd.rule: The crowd in a fight (Pulse, briefs/011/pulse-fight-ai.md §4). A person of the city's people on the street is startled by a shot whose shooter stands within `scatter`, seen or not, or by an operative's drawn weapon within witness range on a clear line: they stand `startle` ticks (a Fearful person `startleFearful`), then flee at `run` by the grid to a refuge of the site's cover data (a door or a street mouth) within `fleeMax` that ends farther from the shooter than they stand, the nearest (ties on id), or if none the refuge farthest from the shooter; there they are sheltered, off the street. `quiet` after the last shot they walk back to the stop their routine has for the clock. Witnesses are taken at the shot, before any startle: a person within witness range with a clear line to the shooter or the target remembers saw-gunfire (place, time, the face). Nobody is hit by a stray shot. A person on the street who is not sheltered blocks a watcher's sightline (the guard, the patrol, a camera, the response unit) that passes within `occlude` of them, between two bodies' width of either end; a hostile's own aim ignores people. The four people the Handover casts by role keep their roles: they do not scatter.
crowd.src: Pulse, briefs/011/pulse-fight-ai.md §4; §06 citizen actions; §05 crowds block guard and camera sightlines
crowd.reason: Pulse's spec; the cast by role keep their places so the mission's contacts stay where its rules need them (Keel).

summon.rule: The summons (Motive, briefs/011/motive-lovers.md §1.3): a turned contact who is called sends for their lover (people.rules ties.kinds.lover), read from the city's ties, never from the mission. The lover leaves where he is, walks the grid to the caller at walking pace (cell.speed), stays `stay` and walks back. Refused, at no cost and with its code, when he is off the street, busy (down, held, engaged in a fight, or already away), more than `walkMax` away, Alert is above `alertMax`, he holds a memory of the cell's gunfire, violence or drawn weapon, or he has come `perShift` times this shift. Alert reaching above `alertMax` ends the visit: he runs back at security's pace. The visit is no act of the cell: the call keeps cell.call.trail. A contact's role job (the driver's camera block) is the call's other use. `together`: a Watch that ends with two lovers within it teaches the cell their affair (people.rules secrets).
summon.src: Motive, briefs/011/motive-lovers.md (2026-10-15); Sky via Aster: Inez and the door guard are lovers, and her call pulls him off the door
summon.reason: systems over scripts: any turned contact with an eligible lover is a lure, in every generated mission (Motive §1.3). Keel models the visit for a lover with a post (the guard), as the Handover needs; another lover is refused until a routine can be left.

cancel.rule: A cancel order stops what one operative is doing now, the activity the HUD shows: an act in progress first, then a walk or run, then a fire order, then a draw, then a loop held, then a downed operative carried. Each verb's line says what cancelling it costs or keeps. stop: the operative stands where they are. holster: a draw not yet done goes back. cease: the fire order ends, the weapon stays drawn. lost: the act's time is spent and nothing lands (Watch and Listen learn nothing; a Loop, Reroute, Mislead or lift not finished does nothing; their Trail is charged only when they land). aborted: the approach stops mid-conversation; the money held for it comes back (the engine holds the price at the order and pays it only in the outcome's charge, Redline E2), no Trail, and the person remembers an aborted approach (memory act `aborted`, with the Fixer's face): it is no refusal, so the approach may be tried again, but it is a fact an investigator can get. ends: the loop stops and the camera comes back. staff-report: the Enforcer comes back out without Vale by the public door, or by the service door if a unit holds the public door, or waits inside while both are held (response; brief 013 E3); the Office staff report the intruder, one reported incident (alert.byIncident). vale-reports: Vale is let go at his car and reports the attempt, one reported incident, and he remembers the aborted take (memory act `aborted`, the Enforcer's face), so an investigator who questions him finds a lead (Motive addendum Q4). put-down: the carried operative is laid down where the carrier stands. Extract is instant and has nothing to cancel. Putting Vale down is no cancel: the Enforcer keeps him (a rule of its own if Sky wants one). The verbs whose line may change take one of: turn aborted or lost; enter staff-report or quiet; take vale-reports or quiet. Brief 013: a takedown cancelled before it lands lets the victim go (`takedown` released): he saw the Enforcer and reports it as a woken victim would; lifting, dropping, stashing or tying a body cancelled spends the time and lands nothing (`body` lost); a body carried is laid down where the carrier stands (`carrying` put-down).
cancel.src: Sky 2026-10-15 playtest: "there's nothing showing me what the cell player is doing when they're busy, nor is there a way to cancel their action" (Aster)
cancel.reason: Accepted by Motive (addendum 2026-10-15 Q4; no put-Vale-down rule in the Handover). Keel's proposal: cancelling an act already under way spends its time and lands nothing, as a refusal does; the money held comes back because it was never handed over; the two acts that put a stranger in front of someone (Enter, Take) leave a report, as an interrupted intrusion would; a broken-off approach leaves the person the Fixer's face but no refusal, so cancel is no free retry of a bad card but no punishment like a refusal either.

perception.rule: A watcher sees a point inside its cone (ahead within reach, and to the side within half × ahead ÷ reach) or within `near` whatever its facing, along a sightline no occluder crosses at eye height (§05 levels: 3D). A camera's cone is its site's; a guard at his door, a walking guard, a chasing patrol, the response unit and the rivals use these. The sweeping patrol's cone widens with depth.
perception.src: §05 cameras, watchers, levels; the top-down test's cones

sight.rule: What the cell knows of each watcher's sight (Sky 2026-10-16: cones are the Scout's skill). A watcher's sight is its perception cone clipped by what blocks sight; the cell knows it only once learned, and learned knowledge stays with the cell (a downed Scout keeps it). learn watch: a completed Watch of the watcher by an operative in its kind's `by` teaches its sight: a camera or the patrol (the machines) is watched by the Scout or the Tech within watch.reach on a clear line (watch.s, the same Watch as a person's); the Tech does not Watch while his loop holds (he is tethered to the cabinet); the guard is watched as the person he is, by the Scout only (scout.watch: routine), and that Watch teaches his sight too. What either learns is the cell's. learn arrival: the response unit and drawn rivals come for the cell, and their sight is known from the moment they are on the street. Knowledge is witnessed (watched) or told (the start state: the briefing, a previous mission). routine fixed: a camera does not move, so its routine is known with its sight; person: the guard's routine is his person routine (scout.watch); watched: the patrol's routine (when its sweep turns and when it sees the door) is known once the cell's completed Watches of it, the Scout's and the Tech's together, total watch.routine seconds; none: no routine. Knowledge changes only what the cards show, never an outcome: a quote's 'seen by' shows each known watcher's true answer, and `unknown` for a watcher the cell doesn't know that stands within its kind's farthest sight of the act or route on a clear line (its facing is what the cell doesn't know), as the action card shows '?' until the temperament is known (§04, Sky Q3). Detection needs no knowledge: a watcher that sees an operative now has noticed them, known or not.

(Sky Q3); §05 cameras, watchers

takedown.rule: The Enforcer's takedown (brief 013, Sky 2026-10-16: anyone can be targeted; one rule set for every simulated person, no named target list). The Enforcer alone, standing within `reach` of a person on the street, knocks them out (`ko`) or kills them (`kill`); silent: none of the gunfire rules apply, no money. Vale may be killed (the mission fails, §07) but not knocked out (use Take); the patrol and cameras are no targets (Reroute and Loop are their verbs). A target who had the Enforcer in his cone when the order was given, heard him running within witness range, or witnessed one of the cell's acts this mission (a takedown, a carry, a drawn weapon: Motive rev 3, until a stop has a facing) is aware: unarmed, he struggles (`struggle` more), screams (heard within witness.scream) and holds the Enforcer's face; armed (a person with a weapon: the door guard), the takedown fails, he draws and engages (Alert at least weapons.costs.drawSeenSecurity at sight). The victim lies where he fell until moved: a body. A knocked-out victim wakes after `wake`, staggers `stagger`, then reports the assault whatever his temperament (a cell contact says nothing); a dead one never wakes or talks. Any operative carries a body (cell.carry lift, then walk only: the Enforcer at cell.speed, the others at carry.untrained; no run, no fire) and puts it down in carry.drop; restrains a living one in `restrain` (no move, no call-out, still seen on open ground; a finder frees him in `free`, then he reports); stashes it, standing at the stash, into a container (`stash.container`, on the street, seen as a carry) or through a service door (`stash.door`, off-screen; a door holds `stash.doorHolds` bodies, a storeroom: rev 4 R4.3; a container what its site entry says). Only a stash hides a body (two hide levels, open and shut; Sky merged call 6). A woken, unrestrained victim in a stash calls out every `callOut`, heard within witness.scream. A container is emptied by a round every `service.period`, its phase from its id, standing `service.dwell`: a body inside is found then (in the mission only; Sky merged call 9). Every number of the takedown, the price and its forecast are on the order's card before it is given.

witness.rule: What a person does when the city's silent violence reaches them (Pulse's decision list; Motive's numbers). Who notices: a takedown or a carry, everyone on the street within witness range on a clear line at any tick of it; an open body, the same, checked every `check.ticks` (phase from the body's id); a live camera, the guard, the patrol and the response's units in their cones; a shut body nobody. The rows, first that holds, evaluated when the person notices: staff (a job in `staff`, or the door guard): radio from where he stands, landing react + postCall (the armed guard, the patrol and the response's units seeing an act or a carry engage instead: Alert at least weapons.costs.drawSeenSecurity at sight); kin of the victim (a tie in `kin`): report at once, whatever the temperament (fear `terrifiedFear`: flee); cell (turned, or loyalty at least values.word-quiet-loyalty): quiet; an Informer (resentment at its max): report; terrified (fear at least `terrifiedFear`): flee, never report; then by temperament: Loyal reports; Idealist reports, after walking to a body to learn its state (`check`); Mercenary reports only once Alert is at least `mercenaryAlert`; Fearful flees an act or carry and avoids a body. A reporter walks the grid to the nearest report point (a staffed door: the site's door refuges; a call box), at walking pace for a body and running pace (crowd.run) for an act or a carry, and calls (`call`): the report lands at the desk; a live camera's lands at its next scan (`cameraScan`, phase from its id) + postCall; a robot's after `robot`. At most `cap` reporters of one incident are in transit; one taken down, killed or carried before his report lands drops it. Whoever quiets, avoids or flees, and every reporter, tells one tie (first kind in `tells`): a tie on the street within `tell` face to face at once; a tie indoors at a unit only from a phone (calls are voice, no networks: GDD §01; Aster 2026-10-16, brief 013 E1). A reporter who walked to a report point tells from its phone when the report lands; one who radios tells face to face only, unless he stands at a report point. A quiet or avoiding person with no tie in speaking range and a tie indoors walks to the nearest report point and calls (`call`), the same walk as a report and stopped the same way (taken down, or Vale taken, before the call: nobody is told); a fleeing one calls only if the refuge her flight ends at is a staffed door. A tell is no report: it is outside `cap` and raises no Alert. A told entry, facts only, one hop (a told person never tells it on); a told Loyal person reports it from where they are. Alert rises when a report lands, never at sight (Sky merged call 1), to `alert` by what it says: a takedown seen `seen`, a carry seen `carry`, a person lying (or a noise from a stash) `down`, a dead body (staff know, an Idealist checks) `dead`, a woken victim `woken`, a missed check-in `mark`, a missing expected person `missing`; a knockout never above takedown.koAlertMax by itself; one takedown is one incident (Alert to the highest of its landed and confirmed reports; the nth reported incident at least alert.byIncident[n-1]). Witness Trail (+values.witness-trail) and Standing (traceable takedown) move once per incident at sight; a turned witness (loyalty at least values.word-quiet-loyalty) adds no Trail, and Standing still moves (Sky merged call 5). A screaming witness (fear at least `screamFear`), kin and an aware victim are heard within `scream` with no line: hearers with a line within witness range become witnesses; the rest hold heard-alarm. A reporter volunteers place and time when questioned (investigator.question, outcome volunteers). Rev 4 (Motive R4.2; Sky 2026-10-16): before every row, an accomplice of the act (a person turned to enable this very act: for the Take and its escort, the turned driver) is never its witness, whatever the tie; `kin` is lover or family only (workmate is not kin; `close`, lover, family and workmate, is whose absence or loss a person feels: expectations, the alarm's places, grief and worry). The Take: at Vale's own car with its driver turned it happens inside the car, off-screen, with no witness window (and nothing for the pickup camera to see); any other Take reads as an act for its first cell.take.struggle s, seen as a takedown by everyone within witness range on a clear line and every watcher that sees him (a live pickup camera still fails it at the order, §07). Escorted on foot, Vale looks wrong only to his kin within witness range on a clear line, or to anyone within values.near-m on a clear line who sees the grip: a carry seen. The Take and its escort are one incident, opened at the first sighting (an unseen Take opens none); witness Trail and Standing move at sight; no assault Trail is charged (the Take keeps cell.take.trailUnturned); Vale let go by a cancel reports on the same incident if it was seen.

response.rule: The response is a dial (Sky 2026-10-16: 'it's easy to swarm the play area with robots'; merged call 3): `levels` indexed by the security level S = the district's base + its open cases (campaign) + the mission's bonus, from the mission's data; the Handover's is 2. A landed alarm (a report of a silent act, a missed check-in, a missing person; gunfire, whose report lands its security.response delay less level 1's dispatch after the shot) puts the response on the street the level's `dispatch` later: at Alert 1 `a1Robots` robots; at Alert 2 or more `a2Units` units of weapons.health.responseOfficers officers (the response unit first) and `a2Robots` robots, then one more unit every `reinforce` up to `unitCap`; Alert 3 adds `a3Units` units to the district mouths (the cordon) and, where `doorsLock`, the doors lock (no Enter). A found body holds the scene (rev 4, Motive R4.1; Sky 2026-10-16): a landed report that a person lies there (down, dead, a takedown seen), the body still there and open, or a woken victim's own report where he woke, brings a unit of officers at any Alert (not bound by robot reach; not one of the dial's counted units; at Alert 2 the response unit is it), the level's dispatch after the landing. The scene holds the entrance the body lies at (within values.near-m) and every entrance within witness range of it on a clear line: from an officer's arrival (its check and its `search.s` sweep, opening stashes only at Alert 2 or more) until the unit stands down (the timers below), a held entrance refuses Enter (`door-held`) and any exit through it; an Enter under way finishes and comes out by a door not held (the service door, else the public door), or waits inside while both are held; a cancelled Enter comes out without Vale by the public door, else the service door, or waits inside while both are held (the wait cannot be cancelled; brief 013 E3). A missed check-in is an empty post, no body: it holds nothing. Counts are kept, not repeated: a later alarm tops them up. One incident is one dispatch (brief 013 D, Aster 2026-10-16): the first landed report of an incident dispatches; a later report of it that raises the Alert tops that dispatch up to the new Alert's counts, from the destinations the first set; any other later report of it sends nothing (a unit already out may be sent on to a scene no unit covers). A robot is a patrol unit (weapons.health.patrol, a pistol, trained) walking at `robotSpeed`; the patrol robot is the first robot when it is on its sweep and answers after `robotWire`; the others and the officers start at the site's docks and posts, else at the response unit's entry; they leave one every `launchGap` ticks. Robots and units stop at `cap` combatants (§06). Destinations, in order, duplicates within witness range dropped: the scene; the missing person's post and the stands his lover, family and workmates are meant to be at now, and his car (up to `spread`); the alarm-raiser's ties likewise (up to `spread`); at Alert 3 the mouths. Robots take them in order, the nearest free robot first, ties on id, each only a place within `robotReach` of where it starts (its dock, or the patrol's place on its sweep): farther places are for officers; units go to the scene, then to the place with the fewest units. A unit within witness range of the scene with a clear line verifies: a body there is confirmed (the act's Trail, a kill's Standing, Alert to the confirmed level; the seal starts only on a confirmation at Alert 2 or more, the level's `seal` after the later of the confirmation and the response unit on the street (the seal is the unit's cordon, as for gunfire; Motive rev 3); a knocked-out victim is brought round and gives his statement); no body is unfounded (Alert stays, no seal). Arriving, a unit checks `check`, then robots hold the point (a watcher) and officers search `search.s`: at Alert 2 or more they open every stash within `search.m` of the scene, nearest first, `search.stash` each; a report from a stash itself (a noise, a round) opens that stash at any Alert. Units stand down `standDown.inquiry` after the last alarm at Alert 1 and `standDown.search` at Alert 2, never at Alert 3. The world places report points and the response's origins by rule, so that every walkable cell is within `world.report` of a report point and within `world.dock` of a dock or post (R-REPORT, R-DOCK, checked by the world's tools; the engine reads the places the world exports). Every staff post checks in by voice every `checkIn` from the start of the shift at the post and at its end: a missed mark is a report that lands at the mark at the post. A person who expects a tie at a stop they share (lover, family, workmate; from the people file's routines, never authored) and is at the place without them, while the tie's routine puts them there and the tie is down, held or stashed, raises the alarm after `suspicion.s` (times `suspicion.pm` by temperament, per mille; default a flat 20 s): a missing-person report from where they stand; a turned waiter says nothing; a person being taken reports nothing.

Alive: not killed by a takedown that landed (so not missing either) and not shot down (the engine does not tell the wounded from the dead)
outcomes in order, so a person both helped and pressured or knocked out counts as harmed

the step goes to the district where the act was done, once per person however many ties (standing.word.ties) they have; the district's net word is clamped to ±cap after every subject is counted (order-free)
a feeling, not a fact: nobody's memory changes, no fact is told, nothing reaches the investigators; word-quiet-loyalty does not apply (it hides facts)
a contact the Fixer has sealed would not tell (briefs/014/motive-standing.md 'who doesn't'): the rulebook has no such verb yet, so nobody is sealed

events.src: Sky 2026-10-16 (approved Motive's 'the benefit of the doubt'); briefs/014/motive-standing.md rule 5

both outcomes write the district's one Standing line (debrief.lines.standing) with its cause from standing.causes
